nom: Drunk Elephant Juju Exfoliating Face Cleansing Bar

segments.dry: Reports from dry-skinned reviewers are mixed: some say the bar is genuinely drying and not suited to dry-prone skin, one reporting it triggered rebound oiliness, while others with dry or mixed dry-oily skin say it left skin soft without stripping it, and one credits it with fading dark spots and improving texture.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are overwhelmingly positive, repeatedly describing the exfoliation as gentle enough for reactive skin, including one with mild rosacea who reports no added redness, and another who is fragrance-sensitive and found the bar unscented and non-drying; one exception found her sensitive/dry skin could only tolerate it a few times a week.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers consistently report good results — smaller-looking pores, clearer skin, and just the right amount of exfoliation without over-drying.
segments.oily: Reviewers dealing with oily or mixed oily areas, including one whose chest became oily from medication, report the bar helps balance and restore the skin without stripping it.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with dry or sensitive skin, describe the bar as non-drying and non-stripping, leaving skin soft rather than tight; a minority dissent sharply, however — one calls it very drying and would not repurchase, another says it dried her skin enough to trigger rebound oiliness, and a third can only use it a few times a week before it feels too drying for her sensitive/dry skin.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers report the bar helps balance oily areas and reduces the look of pores without over-stripping, including one who used it on medication-related oily skin on her chest; one reviewer, however, found that drying her face out with this bar triggered a rebound increase in oiliness.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers with acne-prone skin, including one managing pregnancy-related breakouts, report the bar helped clear their skin and reduced or stopped new breakouts; no reviewer in this set reports it causing new blemishes.
concerns.spots: One reviewer specifically credits the bar with fading dark spots alongside improving her skin's texture and dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with mild rosacea reports the bar's exfoliation is gentle enough to leave her skin calm afterward with no added redness.
concerns.aging: One long-term reviewer felt her fine lines looked reduced after switching to this bar, though she frames this as a subjective impression rather than a measured result.

aspects.libelle: Bar lasts a very long time
Comes wrapped in a bit of plastic
Bar format feels inconvenient to some
Seen as pricey compared to alternatives

extraits.texte: I really thought that the soap will do well for my face but it's very drying and it's causing my face to be dried up. I would not buy again.

I am very sad to write this review as I do love drunk elephant. I purchased the travel duo pekee and juju bar and loved them, which is why I purchased the full size versions. I'm not sure if it was just the batch I got but they both feel like they leave a film on my face and dont actually clean it. They do not feel the same as the travel duo I received so maybe I just got some bad bars, hence the two stars:(

I loved the bar when I first started. But it did make me dry to where I started to get super oily. So I had to cut back. It definitely has a luxurious lather that I love. But if you are prone to getting dry, this may not be for you.

OMG this bar soap has done wonders for my skin. I hadn't bought a bar soap in years and I was a little skeptical but the quality is amazing and it feels like I'm washing my face with a little bit of luxury! It makes me feel like I'm spoiling myself every time I wash my face. I have combo skin and it has cleared my skin and made my pores looks smaller all without drying my face. This soap is leaves my skin feeling so good I honestly could go without putting any product after

I have oily acne prone combination sensitive skin and this has been a staple for me for a few yrs now...I use it every morning gently and I use the Peekee Bar at night. Has set my skin where I no longer break out. I prefer the larger size bar, and it lasts.

I'm such a huge fan of the Juju Bar. I often use it as a second cleanse at night and its base formula is so soothing and non-stripping. The exfoliating bamboo powder is remarkably subtle and gentle - I know physical scrubs can be a huge no-no for sensitive skin, but this is so gentle. I have mild type 1 rosacea and my face feels smooth and calm after use with no added redness. I absolutely recommend!
I was skeptical at first because of the price, does great at exfoliating and getting rid of my dry skin, has genuinely helped my textured skin and has faded dark spots! just don't use it everyday:)
